in_sanskrit.name: कोनार्क
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Konark is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kona' meaning 'corner' and 'Ark' meaning 'sun'. It can be interpreted as 'the corner of the sun' or 'the sun's corner'. The name is believed to be associated with the ancient Sun Temple located in Konark, Odisha, India.
